content_rating.notes: Completed in Google Play Console before the first internal release.

data_safety.notes: Optional, operator-configured Sentry error reporting in every build. Sent only through the user's own Stricknani server (never straight to Sentry), only when the server offers it and the user has not turned Send error reports off. Errors only, no tokens or PII. Console form must match; set completed_in_play_console to true once it does.
